recommendation.choice: Persistent orthogonal waiting blocker, not Task.status waiting
recommendation.reason: Task active/process/done expresses execution lifecycle; overdue is derived. A dependency can block either active or process without substituting lifecycle.
data_fields: DB constraint both nonnull together or both null
recommendation.history: Existing immutable AuditEvent created_at/before/after records begin/end; no separate start timestamp proposed

commands.conditions: Unarchived, not done, no existing wait, current assignee; participant distinct active Employee with active User and department branch
Active wait; explicit end reason; no automatic status change

recommendation.actors: CEO for visible Task; manager only current assignee; observer read only. Expected participant does not automatically clear blocker.
invariants: Preserve existing preview/confirm, transaction.atomic, erp.service.write_lock, fingerprint/CAS/replay path; no raw route.
Retain active/process status; deadline/overdue not paused.
Reject handoff, completion, archive and owner/status changes while waiting; explicit end first.
Validate Task/current assignee/expected participant and recheck role/source/access drift on confirm.
One current blocker only; start/end audit events preserve reasons and actors.
recommendation.projection: Proposed current waiting whitelist with reason and participant id/name/department only; full event history via existing guarded history route. Requires independent disclosure/access review.
recommendation.segmentation: archive -> done -> overdue -> waiting -> process -> active; overdue waiting remains visibly waiting on card, not hidden.

observer_review_caveats: Draft author recommendation is not independent approval. Root selects/reviews exact contract before appointing implementation.
Independently verify participant source-access/visibility and whether displaying free-text reason through list projection preserves current Policy boundaries.
Verify employee deactivation/deletion, access revision, stale proposals, lock ordering and lifecycle edges; do not assume current handoff policy automatically covers new waiting behavior.
Two persistent fields imply a new migration: this proposal grants no migrate/seed/DB/runtime permission and cannot be applied via source-only owner-local delivery preservation rules.
Current B30-UXD03-CARD allowlist excludes backend/waiting; keep UI author isolated and preserve full UXD requirement beyond display-only work.
